TOPIC 3.3

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

FUN-3.E
Calculate derivatives 
of inverse and inverse 
trigonometric functions.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

FUN-3.E.1
The chain rule and definition of an inverse 
function can be used to find the derivative of an 
inverse function, provided the derivative exists.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

FUN-3
Recognizing opportunities to apply derivative rules can simplify differentiation.
